Loved this build, @{author}. The way you handled {specific_part} is clean — most people skip that and it bites them later.

I run a small AI automation studio and built something in the same spirit. Sharing in case it's useful as a reference:

What I built:
- A lead capture workflow that reads from a Google Sheet, scores each lead with OpenAI, and writes the score back to a second Sheet
- Slack notification for any lead above a threshold
- Daily summary email with the top 3 leads

Stack: n8n + OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) + Google Sheets API + Slack webhook
Time to build: ~3 hours including error handling

What I learned the hard way:
- Always paginate the Sheets API (first version of mine missed rows 100+)
- Cap the prompt at 2k tokens or you eat cost spikes
- Add a Switch node to handle missing/empty fields gracefully

If anyone wants the JSON export, happy to share. And @{author} — would love to see what you do with the {feature} extension.

Cheers,
Salim
AI Automation Engineer
